email.body1:
Jennifer, saw Olo is rolling out the Olo App and Olo Network, opening brands to data across the whole restaurant base.

A platform shift that big usually surfaces more enterprise accounts than the team can cover before they cool off, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Olo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jennifer, quick follow-up on Olo's enterprise motion.

When a network launch expands the addressable base, board pipeline targets jump faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Olo needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jennifer, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olo's enterprise reply rate likely compares to other restaurant-tech leaders. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jennifer, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right as a network launch reshapes the funnel, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Olo either way.
